verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents a GitHub integration where developers mention @gemini-cli in issues and pull requests for debugging, explanations, or task delegation, plus automated PR reviews and issue triage. A community comment also references the GitHub Action. Nothing in the evidence covers kicking off tasks from GitLab, Linear, or Slack. Missing for 10: GitLab triggering, Linear triggering, Slack triggering, in-depth setup docs for the GitHub trigger flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can kick off agent tasks directly from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack

citations.quote: Mention @gemini-cli in issues and pull requests for help with debugging, explanations, or task delegation
Pull Request Reviews: Automated code review with contextual feedback and suggestions
Issue Triage: Automated labeling and prioritization of GitHub issues based on content analysis
